name: neorest-monorepo
description: REST APIs with WebSockets. Do regular REST operations (GET, POST, DELETE) on routes, and subscribe to them.
author: Dmitry Kury (https://dkury.com)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @neorest/core && npm run build -w @neorest/router-core && npm run build -w @neorest/router-node && npm run build -w neorest
scripts.pretest: npx tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/router-core/tsconfig.json packages/router-node/tsconfig.json packages/neorest/tsconfig.json
